title: Restarting from checkpoints (R41): classified audit, recovery decided by it
note: CR1-CR8: each checkpoint class told apart, NONE_USABLE and UNPARSEABLE never healthy, a checkpoint never used when none describes the log, the weaker trust reported, the governed runtime restarting through the audit.

mutations.name: CR1_stale_called_foreign
mutations.rationale: a checkpoint ahead of a truncated log reads as another log's

mutations.name: CR2_corrupt_unclassified
mutations.rationale: a corrupt checkpoint disappears from the classification

mutations.name: CR3_none_usable_healthy
mutations.rationale: a recovery whose checkpoints are all useless reports health

mutations.name: CR4_unparseable_healthy
mutations.rationale: a corrupt newest checkpoint is skipped as if nothing were wrong

mutations.name: CR5_checkpoint_when_none_usable
mutations.rationale: a recovery reports CHECKPOINT_ASSISTED when nothing describes the log

mutations.name: CR6_trust_overstated
mutations.rationale: a checkpoint-assisted load reports a verified prefix

mutations.name: CR7_runtime_ignores_checkpoints
mutations.rationale: the governed runtime replays from genesis whatever it is given, so checkpoint health gates nothing

mutations.name: CR8_newest_not_selected
mutations.rationale: recovery reports the oldest usable checkpoint as the one it used

mutations.name: CR9_a_byte_shortfall_is_read_as_lost_records
mutations.find: if last is not None and last >= cp.seq:
mutations.rationale: D-2026-109: a foreign checkpoint whose records are longer is classed AHEAD_OF_LOG, records removed, instead of FOREIGN_LOG

mutations.name: CR10_a_torn_tail_is_read_as_a_record
mutations.find: lines = tail.split(b"\n")[:-1]           # drop a torn or empty remainder
mutations.rationale: the torn fragment after the last newline is parsed as the last record, so a crash mid-append hides the log's real head
